mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS artistNickname, u.avatar AS artistAvatar FROM dimension_commission_plan p LEFT JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_commission_plan (artist_id, title, price, delivery_days, cover_url, status, content_type, create_time) VALUES (#{artistId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{deliveryDays}, #{coverUrl}, #{status}, #{contentType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS artistNickname, u.avatar AS artistAvatar FROM dimension_commission_plan p INNER JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND u.artist_status = 2 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_commission_plan p INNER JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND u.artist_status = 2
SELECT * FROM dimension_user WHERE artist_status = 2 AND accept_commission = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_user WHERE artist_status = 2 AND accept_commission = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dimension_user SET accept_commission = #{accept} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_commission_order (order_no, plan_id, buyer_id, artist_id, requirement, amount, status, content_type, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{planId}, #{buyerId}, #{artistId}, #{requirement}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{contentType}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, p.title AS planTitle, p.delivery_days AS deliveryDays, b.nickname AS buyerNickname, b.avatar AS buyerAvatar, a.nickname AS artistNickname, a.avatar AS artistAvatar FROM dimension_commission_order o LEFT JOIN dimension_commission_plan p ON p.id = o.plan_id LEFT JOIN dimension_user b ON b.id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN dimension_user a ON a.id = o.artist_id
